events.verdict: RHH confirms Warren (PHX) cleanly strips the ball on Embiid's (PHI) shot.
Redick (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Ariza's (PHX) jump shot.
Warren (PHX) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is taken.
Ayton (PHX) makes marginal contact with Embiid (PHI) during the rebound.
Ariza (PHX) brings one hand to the opposite side of Embiid's (PHI) body but immediately slides it off.
Embiid (PHI) initiates contact with Ariza (PHX) but the contact is marginal. Ariza's reaction is not consistent with the level of contact.
Warren (PHX) kicks-outs unnaturally into Simmons (PHI) when contact occurs on his jump shot attempt.
Bridges (PHX) cleanly steals the ball from Redick (PHI) and does not dislodge him during the loose ball.
Embiid (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Bridges's (PHX) shot.
[Observable in enhanced video] Redick (PHI) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Chandler (PHI) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Ayton (PHX) makes contact with Redick's (PHI) body during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Simmons (PHI) moves toward Booker (PHX) but establishes a legal guarding position and when the contact occurs during the jump shot attempt.
Bridges (PHX) does not step out of bounds after receiving the pass.
Ariza (PHX) brings two hands the opposite side of Chandler's (PHI) body and does not remove them as he moves away.
